description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Impose Special Commodity levy for Birds Eggs etc. and other Sweetening Matter
reasoning: This gazette notification imposes and modifies a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders regarding tax rates and waivers for specific imported commodities (eggs and fish), making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
